retrievalProfile.description: A soft-focus studio portrait featuring a central subject with warm, golden-hour lighting and elegant italicized display typography at the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a woman with dark hair and bangs, resting her chin on her hand. The lighting is warm and diffused, creating a soft glow on the skin. The background consists of out-of-focus, warm-toned draped fabric. Elegant, wide-spaced italicized serif text sits at the top edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the central focal point
Warm background tones complementing the subject's skin and hair
Typography positioned to frame the top of the head
Hand placement creating a diagonal line toward the face
coreInvariants: Warm amber and gold color palette
Italicized serif typography with wide tracking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright white collar of the shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top typography down to the eyes, following the curve of the hair to the hand and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, filled with textured, out-of-focus fabric drapes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ambers and golds in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and purples in the clothing and hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white of the shirt collar and magenta-pink lip color.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm tones with soft, low-contrast transitions between light and shadow.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or harsh neon colors

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'K' and 'T' are slightly larger for emphasis
Lowercase 'y' has a graceful, elongated tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for the main name, often paired with a small geometric logo in the corner.
graphicDevices: Diamond-shaped logo in the bottom corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a dark jacket and white collar, against a warm amber draped fabric background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist's name in a white, high-contrast italic serif font at the top, using wide tracking and a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and diffused?
Is the text italicized with high contrast?
Is the subject's pose centered with a hand-to-face gesture?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the original artist
Ensure the text is a generic placeholder name
postGenerationChecks: Check for soft-focus consistency across the image
Verify the typography is centered and properly spaced
Ensure the warm amber tones dominate the background
Confirm the subject's expression is soft and engaging
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Warm Amber Glow + Soft Focus + Italic Serif Header
